• Director 4 – 21.90 % | | **Audit** | Audited each year by “Audit Firm 1” – unqualified opinion | ### Financial Snapshot (RM) | Year | Revenue | Gross Profit | Operating Profit (Loss) | Net Profit (Loss) | Total Assets | Total Liabilities | Equity | |------|---------|--------------|--------------------------|-------------------|--------------|-------------------|--------| | **2022** | 36.02 M | 20.68 M | **‑1.96 M** | **‑2.46 M** | 55.61 M | 27.80 M | 27.81 M | | **2023** | 34.22 M | 17.72 M | **‑2.82 M** | **‑3.29 M** | 52.83 M | 28.32 M | 24.52 M | | **2024** | 32.08 M | 19.15 M | **‑4.03 M** | **‑4.47 M** | 49.53 M | 29.49 M | 20.05 M | **Key trends (2022‑2024)** * Revenue has been falling modestly (≈ ‑11 % over three years). * Gross margin stayed healthy (≈ 57 % in 2024) but operating margins deteriorated, moving from –5.5 % (2022) to –12.6 % (2024). * Net loss widened each year, reaching **‑RM 4.47 M** in 2024. * Liquidity is tight: quick ratio improved to **0.91** in 2024 but remains below 1; cash‑to‑revenue rose to **21.4 %**. * Leverage increased (debt‑to‑equity ≈ 1.47 in 2024) and interest‑coverage is negative (‑9.1×), indicating insufficient earnings to cover interest. * Operating cash flow is consistently negative, leading to growing free‑cash‑flow deficits. ### Operational Efficiency (2024) * Cash conversion cycle: **≈ 43 days** (reasonable for a food‑manufacturing business). * Inventory turnover: **4.17 ×** per year. * Receivables turnover: **7.98 ×** per year. ### Litigation * No court cases or legal disputes recorded. --- **Bottom‑line:** Mega Mutiara Catering is an established, privately‑held bakery manufacturer in Penang. While it maintains solid gross margins, the company has been experiencing declining sales, widening operating losses, and increasing leverage over the past three years. Liquidity is improving but remains below the ideal threshold, and negative cash‑flow persists. No litigation issues are noted.
